g.title: AoiRank5Convo4 begins.
g.text: AoiRank5Convo4 begins.

g.title: j1347069611
g.text: Quincy told me he'd kill me if I ever told anyone this story

g.title: j1539929126
g.text: but he's all talk and u and I are so very close now so I'm just gonna get it off my chest

g.title: j2145521757
g.text: sorry ur involved now <3

g.title: j3281216665
g.text: Uuh no I'm not. Don't tell me. I'm not signing up for a problem with Quincy.

g.title: j4071027925
g.text: Tell me everything.

g.title: j593005680
g.text: u sure? last chance!

g.title: j2113243450
g.text: ok, so we were on this mission to sabotage Scaldra weapon production. I was doing the metalwork, Quincy had my back, watching for any patrols.

g.title: j1680960625
g.text: Who am I kidding? Yes, tell me everything.

g.title: j792859353
g.text: I'm sure.

g.title: j2460192642
g.text: it went supers smoothly! exactly as planned, but on our way back, we got stopped by a bunch of kids. they recognized Quincy instantly.

g.title: j707666964
g.text: k! can't say I blame u

g.title: j1730923421
g.text: Sorry, was that a typo? I'm sure you meant "we got stopped by a bunch of SCALDRA who recognized Quincy instantly."

g.title: j1588670707
g.text: Oh no. Those poor kids must have been terrified.

g.title: j3314313750
g.text: Kids?

g.title: Chat ends.
g.text: Chat ends.

g.title: j4285677432
g.text: nope, I mean it! kids! cute, smiley, not-at-all-scared-of-Quincy's-angry-mug kids!

g.title: j315216620
g.text: not quite!

g.title: j3436298263
g.text: u heard me!

g.title: j3738223268
g.text: So, what did he do when they stopped him?

g.title: j208514462
g.text: Well, what did he do?

g.title: j1771182392
g.text: guess!

g.title: j724353647
g.text: Used colorful language and no uncertain terms to tell them to get out of his way?

g.title: j2329820884
g.text: Shoved past them?

g.title: j2529562620
g.text: Ignored them?

g.title: j1732925126
g.text: Was he... really nice to them?

g.title: j66447660
g.text: see, that's totally what I thought was going to happen, but no!

g.title: j1254591245
g.text: why yes he was! you know our Quincy better than I thought <3

g.title: j209773784
g.text: he SMILED at them. it was like he forgot I was there for sec. dropped the whole tough guy act

g.title: j512274644
g.text: Those kids must have adored him.

g.title: j4279623193
g.text: They knew him from POSITIVE interactions?

g.title: j2361456675
g.text: You're kidding.

g.title: j3255751715
g.text: he knew them by name! "Hey Miko, I found one of those tammpets you told me about. Swiped it for ya."

g.title: j3035195118
g.text: So, Quincy went on a side quest to find a tammpet for some Höllvanian kid?

g.title: j1843131274
g.text: He... said that?

g.title: j168678275
g.text: You're definitely kidding.

g.title: j2606348048
g.text: I swear on Zeke's life!

g.title: j3873304499
g.text: Quincy actually pulled one of those little digital pet things out of his pocket and gave it to the kid.

g.title: j3566677652
g.text: Sol only knows how long he'd had it, or how long he'd spent searching through Höllvania to find it

g.title: j1703294666
g.text: once that funny little horned creature appeared on the screen, I don't know who was smiling bigger. the kid or Quincy seeing the kid so happy

g.title: j1788467663
g.text: Boolean QuincyLovesKids is now true.

g.title: j1988790463
g.text: You know, now that I'm picturing it, that really does sound like him.

g.title: j599644065
g.text: You'll have to excuse me for finding this story hard to believe.

g.title: j15505262
g.text: You're lucky you got to see that side of him. I bet few people ever do.

g.title: j1992175167
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j2424922365
g.text: I know, right? I was stunned.

g.title: j3146379783
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j403343765
g.text: u think? either ur hella good at reading people or u and Quincy have a special bond <3

g.title: j622755575
g.text: of course then he looked me dead in the eye and said, "if u tell anybody about this, I'll kill u"

g.title: j498551830
g.text: Classic Quincy.

g.title: j1108967563
g.text: You risked your life to tell me this story?!

g.title: j2219027496
g.text: Your secret is safe with me.

g.title: j3200059249
g.text: Looks like you've signed your death warrant.

g.title: j1161761629
g.text: ya <3

g.title: j573575625
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j864254571
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j2687706785
g.text: at least the story will live on through u ^_^

g.title: j3843445087
g.text: he pretends he’s all about the mission, but deep down, he’s got a heart of gold. he still goes out sometimes just to bring a bit of happiness to those kids

g.title: j23896584
g.text: psssh he doesn't scare me! how could he now that I know what a big softy he is? ;)

g.title: j1572674830
g.text: aaw it's ok u don't need to keep it secret <3 I'm prepared to face the consequences

g.title: j3686411941
g.text: Think he could find me a tammpet?

g.title: j4095581971
g.text: Honestly, it's nice to hear such a happy story about our brooding sniper.

g.title: j3004995977
g.text: Aren't you kind of betraying his trust telling me all this though?

g.title: j2047463639
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j1602067995
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j2047969917
g.text: aah he knew I'd tell. If he really cared, he would have just asked me not to. not made some empty threat.

g.title: j1507080495
g.text: LOL maybe! we've gotta find his supplier for sure

g.title: j3875009775
g.text: I knew u'd appreciate it!

g.title: j3426180731
g.text: this tale does arm u with powerful knowledge. promise to only use this power for good?

g.title: j2736758399
g.text: Okay. I promise.

g.title: j435802792
g.text: Pinky swear.

g.title: j4290799746
g.text: Nah, I'm going to make fun of him.

g.title: j341737065
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j821208832
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j3719134340
g.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_GLARE>

g.title: j1031309257
g.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_HAPPYHAND>

g.title: j3067295892
g.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_SMITTEN>

g.title: j2335311088
g.text: u do that, and I crush u with every piece of metal on ur body

g.title: j2029544389
g.text: gosh we make a good team

g.title: j529406461
g.text: Quincy? Is that you?

g.title: j1186188335
g.text: Guess that's the end of me wearing metal.

g.title: j375265754
g.text: LOL! just play nice with our Quincy, k?
